notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
We just released patch 1.2, which improves the overall performance, adds 19:10 resolutions and fixes some minor issues.

Patchlog:

- Overall performance improvement (especially in episode 7).
- Fixed a bug that sometimes toggled crouching.
- The achievement for the second boss works now.
- Fixed various checkpoints (on some levels, the checkpoint complete icons 
  were displayed wrong in the main menu).
- Minor difficulty balancing in episode 5, 13 and 17.
- The end sequence can now be triggered with the controller.
- Fixed an error that put some platforms below the acid in episode 21.
- Fixed an error that prevented some candy meat to be added to the total 
  number.
- Fixed an error that prevented the last gold ed from beeing saved.
- Fixed an error that crashed the game in episode 17 for some people.
- The last Robot Boss button can now also be triggered by ed jumping on it.
- Fixed the rotation speed of the round platforms in Episode 7 for lower frame  
  rates.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
We just released patch 1.1, which fixes some minor isses and improves the performance in Episode 3 and 7.

Patchlog:

- Lighting issues in Episode 3 and Episode 7 fixed
- Collision for cameraman fixed
- Performance optimization in Episode 3 and Episode 7
- Added revert y-axis option
- Clown rotation speed reduced on level one and two
- Difficulty balancing in Episode 3 and 7
- Improved functionality of round breakable dodge wall
- Fixed problem for AZERTY keyboards, that led to problems in "head-mode"
